steps.text: 1. A moderation event occurs (tour.ai_rejected, tour.approved, tour.rejected, tour.changes_requested, tour.hidden, tour.restored, tour.reported).
2. The system (Notification) first stores an in-app notification for the author, then sends an email (except tour.reported); the email comes from the event or is looked up in Auth by author ID.
3. When the app opens, when the tab is shown again and every 60 seconds, the system updates the unread count on the bell (above 99 shows "99+"). E2.

exceptions.text: E2. No network → the bell keeps the last known count.

steps.text: 5. The system opens the Notifications page: newest first, 20 items at a time, an "Unread" filter and a "Show more" button; each notification has a type label (Approved, AI changes needed, Rejected, Needs changes, Report, AI audio, System for account notifications; other types show "Notification"). E1, E4.

exceptions.text: E1. No notifications yet → "No notifications yet" (Unread filter: "No unread notifications").

steps.text: 6. The Contributor picks a notification. A1.
7. The system marks the notification as read and opens the matching tour in the Studio (or the Account page for account notifications, A3). E3.

exceptions.text: E3. The notification does not exist or is not one's own → 404; the client ignores the error and still opens the target page.

steps.text: 8. The Studio shows the tour's current status (9 statuses) with the reason and the tour's notification history. A2.

steps: A1. Mark all as read: the Contributor taps "Mark all as read"; the bell count goes to 0 and "Marked N notifications as read" is shown.
A3. Account notifications (warning, suspension, ban, restore – UC#21) open the Account page.
A2. The tour is rejected or needs changes: the Contributor edits the tour according to the reason (UC#09–UC#12) and resubmits (UC#15).
